title: Refracting Filippov systems: sliding dynamics without sliding regions
summary: This paper develops fundamental mathematical theory for refracting Filippov systems. These are discontinuous ordinary differential equations with solutions defined in the sense of Filippov, and whose first Lie derivatives vary continuously across discontinuity surfaces. Unlike generic Filippov systems, discontinuity surfaces consist only of crossing regions and their boundaries where both adjacent vector fields are tangent to the discontinuity surface.
